question: Who among the following is India’s highest wicket taker in test cricket as of December 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anil Kumble.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Former Indian leg spinner and former coach of the Indian Team, **Anil Kumble **is the highest wicket-taker in test cricket. 
 
• He has taken** 619 wickets** in **132 matches** with a strike rate of 66. 
 
• The leading wicket-taker of all-time in men's international tests is Sri Lanka's **Muttiah Muralitharan.**
 
• This spin bowler took **800 wickets **in a Test career of **133 matches** from **1992 to 2010.**
